integrity: All infinite statements have an analytic proof from beta-function moments and weighted Cauchy-Schwarz. The supplied exact-arithmetic checker is supplemental; historical originality and proof have not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Strict curvature conclusions are proved only on the central analytic spine, not globally throughout the domain. Mixed positivity is for distinct transverse coordinate directions, not arbitrary pairs. Kernel formulas are previously established; the novelty assessment concerns the curvature-sign classification.
title: Negative sectional and positive mixed bisectional Bergman curvature along the spine of intersected disk bundles
